method.unit: one block contains baseline C, baseline Ada, candidate C, candidate Ada
method.balance: exact position and adjacent-pair balance per four blocks; incomplete final cycles retained
method.repetitions: identical for all four treatments, calibrated from all four CPU-time probes
method.preparation_checksum: outside both clocks according to unchanged matrix driver
method.switch_scope: whole driver sample, including preparation and checksum
method.intervals: individual per-case percentile bootstrap 95% CI of within-block ratio median; no multiplicity correction
method.limitations: within-session intervals do not capture independent-session drift; within_noise is inconclusive, not proven equivalence
method.retention: all samples retained; no context-switch or outlier filtering
method.comparison_scope: candidate C/baseline C is a drift or code-generation/layout control, not an assumed constant
